subject: Re: Acme trial 14 procurement readiness & billing start
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Thompson <alice@acme.com>, Charlie Gomez <charlie.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Alice / Charlie —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: validate Redwood for customer-facing summarization pipeline during a 30-day trial starting Nov 1.
- Success criteria: sustained throughput of ~50k tokens/day with P95 latency < 600ms and acceptable quality on our sample prompts.
- Primary decision factors: procurement (PO vs card), invoicing cadence, and marketplace options for procurement ease.

Open items / asks for your procurement team:
1) Which commercial path do you prefer for production after trial — Purchase Order (PO) or corporate card for initial conversion?
2) If PO, approximate timelines and any required contract language or SOW items we should include.
3) Any interest in procuring via AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace (we can provide a consolidated marketplace quote).
4) Confirm that billing start can align with the trial end date (Nov 30) if usage/QA checks pass.

I'll attach a baseline SOW and an invoice template for your procurement team to review. Ben and Rafael are looped in for pricing and legal redlines.

Proposed next steps:
- Alice / procurement: indicate preferred commercial path and any PO timelines
- We (Redwood): provide SOW + formal quote; happy to do a short procurement call with your buyer
- Technical: we'll schedule a check-in at day 10 of the trial to review telemetry and adjust quotas

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf; Invoice_Template.xlsx

From: Alice Thompson <alice@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Charlie Gomez <charlie.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. From procurement's perspective:
- We generally prefer a PO for anything expected to continue beyond an evaluation. Card can be used for small, one-off purchases but we'd likely want a PO for production billing.
- Timeline: if we have the SOW/quote this week, procurement can issue a PO in ~7–10 business days, assuming no major legal changes.
- Marketplace: we prefer marketplace purchases where available (simplifies invoicing), but it depends on price parity and available SKUs.

I'll connect you to our security contact (Bob Lane) separately — he may have a few SOC2/data residency questions.

Cc'ing procurement for visibility.

Best,
Alice Thompson
Head of Product Operations | Acme Corporation
alice@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Thompson <alice@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Thanks Alice — helpful. Quick follow-ups: 

1) We'll prepare and send a formal SOW + quote today (attaching Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf and Invoice_Template.xlsx). Ben, Rafael — please confirm list price and any short-term promo we can apply for trial-to-paid conversions.

2) Marketplace: we can provide both a marketplace SKU and a direct contract. If Acme prefers marketplace, we can surface the marketplace quote; price parity should hold but I'll confirm.

3) Billing start date: is it acceptable if billing begins the day after the trial end (Dec 1) conditional on meeting the success criteria? If procurement needs billing to begin on the trial end, we can accommodate but want to confirm final cutover window.

4) Success criteria readback: 50k tokens/day sustained; P95 latency < 600ms on your sample prompt set; quality threshold = 85% agreement with your evaluation rubric. Confirm if that matches your expectations.

If procurement can issue PO in ~7–10 business days after receiving the SOW, that would line up for a Dec/early-Jan start date for paid billing. Happy to do a 15–20 minute procurement Q&A if helpful.

Thanks — sending the assets now.

Cheers,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments included: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf; Invoice_Template.xlsx

Marissa / Alice —

Procurement confirms:
- Preferred path: PO for production. We will review the SOW and aim to issue a PO within 7–10 business days after receipt.
- Tentative PO issuance date: 2026-11-30 (subject to legal review).
- Billing start: we prefer invoices dated the first day of the paid term (Dec 1) and can accommodate a Dec 1 billing start assuming trial success metrics are met.
- Success criteria confirmed: 50k tokens/day sustained, P95 latency < 600ms. Please include these acceptance criteria in the SOW.

Attached the invoice template for your finance team to populate.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
